feature: weighted_target resolver membership promotion and draining

scope.source: one hostname logical source inside weighted_target and ring_hash
scope.updates: physical address A to physical address B
scope.active_rpc: old worker remains alive through completion after retirement

contracts: resolver addresses retain one logical hierarchical source identity
a replacement membership is promoted only after its candidate is usable
picker snapshots invalidate when source membership changes
retired workers drain active RPCs before transport and policy state destruction

implementation.identity: hierarchical_path and explicit ring_hash_key remain on the logical hostname source across address replacement
implementation.promotion: pending membership becomes current after the B worker reaches READY
implementation.ring: promotion invalidates every child-local ring before the next pick
implementation.watch: the old physical endpoint tracker transitions to SHUTDOWN and the replacement tracker reaches READY
implementation.drain: retirement removes old capacity immediately but Worker lifetime continues until its active list is empty
implementation.authority: the logical resolve.test authority and original port remain unchanged when the resolver publishes B's physical port

native_case: initial refresh publishes server A and one weighted/ring logical endpoint
second A RPC remains active behind a barrier
B reaches READY before atomic promotion
next hash routes to B after ring rebuild
barrier release lets the retired A worker finish its original RPC
verification_commands: zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='gRPC weighted target ring rebuilds after resolver promotion' --summary all
remaining_gap: dynamic service-config child removal retention and ordinary Channel remain before broad weighted_target completion
